text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin kept working part-time jobs to 
send money home for her family. It seems 
she's doing her very best as the big 
sister of the house.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, preparations for the race were in 
full swing. Her coworkers at her part-time 
job cooperated by adjusting their shifts 
for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of the people who cheered her 
on, calling her running their "hope" and 
"dream"—Ines Fujin fired herself up with 
determination.
